videos.title: Why Are There Bugs in Your Bird Seed? How to Store Seed, Freeze It & Stop Pantry Moths
videos.description:
Why are there bugs in your bird seed?? 🦋 It's more common than you think, especially this time of year! videos.title: Heavy Rain Means Your Bird Feeders Need Attention, and Fast
videos.description:
Heavy rain means your bird feeders need attention, and fast. Once seed gets wet and moldy, birds will stop visiting altogether. In this video, I'm sharing two easy cleaning methods: a DIY vinegar soak followed by a hot water and Dawn dish soap scrub, or a soak using a commercial cleaner like Mr. Bird or Carefree Enzymes. For tube feeders specifically, a long brush like the one from Songbird Essentials makes all the difference. Everything shown is available at ForTheWildBirds.com under Crinda's Picks. Happy Birding!

videos.description:
Suet or dough? Here's the real difference 🐦

Dough is just a drier, less messy version of suet, ideal for spring and summer heat. In this video we're highlighting Wildlife Sciences suet and dough, featuring woodpecker dough and peanut dough, just two of the many flavors available in store.

Hot pepper suet is its own product, not a dough, and it's a great way to keep squirrels and raccoons off your feeders.

We also carry Mr. Bird seed cakes with bugs, nuts, and fruit, a compressed seed option that's not suet but just as loved by backyard birds.

We also walk through feeder options: single cage, double sided cage for multiple woodpeckers, side mounted cages, and our homegrown tray style feeder. Full details in the description!

videos.title: Is your bird bath a bacteria breeding ground? 🪙 Let's fix that with a simple copper trick!
videos.description:
Is your bird bath a bacteria breeding ground? 🪙 Let's fix that with a simple copper trick! The Erva copper disc goes divot-side down, letting water flow around it while copper ions naturally slow bacteria and algae growth. No disc? Pre-1982 pennies or a bit of copper tubing work too. Bonus tip: add rocks for varying water levels so birds can drink and bathe with ease. Still need regular cleanings, but this makes maintenance so much easier!

videos.title: Hummingbird Migration Is Happening RIGHT NOW (Here's What To Do) 🐦
videos.description:
Hummingbird Migration Is Happening RIGHT NOW (Here's What To Do)

Our friend Sherry sent us this beautiful hummingbird footage from Mt. Olive, Arkansas! While Omaha waits for more visitors, we're using this as a reminder: August and September are peak hummingbird migration months across the US.

These tiny birds are heading south for winter and need fuel stops along the way. Keep your feeder filled with fresh nectar, think of it as a hummingbird gas station. This is actually the time of year Nebraska sees the MOST hummingbird activity, so don't take those feeders down yet!

Video credit: Sherry, Mt. Olive, AR
